args.content:
import sys

from .core import count_words, longest_word, top_words


def main(argv=None):
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if len(argv) != 1:
        print("usage: textstats <file>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with open(argv[0], encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()
    print(f"words: {count_words(text)}")
    print(f"longest: {longest_word(text)}")
    print("top words:")
    for word, n in top_words(text, 5):
        print(f"  {word}: {n}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
